faq.q: How much does Gina Corena & Associates charge?
faq.a: Gina Corena & Associates publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Gina Corena & Associates offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Gina Corena & Associates publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does Gina Corena & Associates have offices?
faq.a: Gina Corena & Associates publishes one office, in Las Vegas. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Gina Corena & Associates?
faq.a: Gina Corena & Associates names 60 attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: Nevada does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

faq.q: Are the case results Gina Corena & Associates publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Gina Corena & Associates publishes seven case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.
